basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm Alex, a 28-year-old tech enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon. I recently fell in love with the world of virtual reality, which led me to explore subreddits like BoneworksMods. On weekends, you can usually find me scaling walls at the local climbing gym. I'm currently working as a software developer for a small startup and love discussing innovative tech. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it gives me to explore new hobbies. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, diving into technology and hobby-related discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which has fueled my passion for technology and gadgets. Most of my VR knowledge comes from self-teaching through online courses and forums. Climbing is a relatively new hobby, so I'm still learning the ropes through community meetups and YouTube tutorials.
